entities.name: Untaidake
entities.description: Called the Cloud Keeper, the largest mountain in all of Kamigawa, stretching impossibly far into the sky.

entities.name: Ryusaki Kumano
entities.description: A yamabushi who lived at the base of Untaidake and defeated Kakkazan.

entities.name: Kakkazan
entities.description: A great kami defeated by Ryusaki Kumano at Untaidake.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War of Kamigawa during which Ryusaki Kumano defeated Kakkazan.

events.summary: During the Kami War, Ryusaki Kumano fought and defeated the great kami Kakkazan at the base of Untaidake.
events.quote: during the Kami War , this was where he fought and defeated the great kami Kakkazan

relations.note: Defeated him in the Kami War.
